name: Clash of Vikings
summary: This strategy-based Viking battle game places two kingdoms against each other in fast-paced, three-minute matches. Players build a deck of cards featuring troops, heroes, and spells, then deploy units on the battlefield to overcome the opposing kingdom. The game includes an interactive tutorial that introduces core mechanics, while advanced tactics are learned through play. Features include customization for card decks, a variety of unit and spell types, and AI opponents designed to adapt to different strategies, all presented in a Viking-themed setting.
